caption: The drawing depicts two detailed illustrations of spoons, both rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a light beige textured paper. Each spoon is oriented horizontally with the bowl to the left and the handle to the right. The top spoon shows the front view, with shading indicating the curvature of the bowl and handle, and the end of the handle features an oval-shaped area with the engraved text "L.C.M." and some decorative flourishes around it. The bottom spoon shows the back view, including visible hallmarks or maker's marks stamped onto the back of the handle near the bowl. Below these main drawings, there is a small, rectangular technical diagram showing a top-down view of a spoon with precise measurements: the full length is noted as 8 1/4 inches, and the bowl's width is marked as 2 3/8 inches. The overall composition is centered within a single-line rectangular border, and in the bottom right corner, there are the words "SCALE 1/1" and a small signature or note, "Chilton."
title: Silver Spoon
